limitations: Head and wattle landmarks are manual source estimates, not proven deformed contact.
Nest is three-quarter perspective; review against scene viewpoint.
Crow, laying and combat not visually accepted from source atlas alone.

registration.constraint: Keep a single uniform material pixel scale for both heads; register each state eye to the same world eye. Recompute command center/rect offset and neckRoot from each state landmarks; never reuse old rooster tile1 as the closed crow pose.

layerContract.wattle: root attaches to throat behind beak, not standalone red balloon; closed/open heads already contain wattle so avoid doubling
layerContract.flightFeather: independent hit-event particle with quill pivot, no repeated spawn on seek
layerContract.egg: pelvis/behind-body emergence then nest, bottom pivot after landing
layerContract.nest: floor-bottom anchor; generated three-quarter shallow bowl, not strict orthographic side
